style: Avant-garde garage rock and music-hall brass band, quartal suspended chord fields with microtonal rubbing, fast chromatic cabaret patter opening into soaring operatic melisma, irregular 7/8 asymmetric meter with half-time stomp and punk silences, upright slap bass, distorted sax, cheap pump organ, surf guitar, spring reverb, stacked doo-wop harmony, rapid patter, theatrical overstatement, public-access earnestness with nervous broadcast urgency, 1960s mono tape saturation with frequency gating and analog static. Hold the line! / The paperwork's ninety percent alkaline! / We lost the control parameter somewhere in space! / A demon with spreadsheets is running the place! / The rubber stamps shatter against the abyss, / There is nothing quite as terrifying as this! / [GUITAR SOLO: frantic surf-rock tremolo over chaotic horn stabs] [VERSE 3] The metaphysical ecology is cracking apart! / I've got micro-second attention right from the start! / The Ringmaster's top hat is melting away! / We scheduled tomorrow at three yesterday! / What is the meaning of soul-transfer dread? / When nobody's living and nobody's dead? / The fluorescent lights are buzzing in binary code, / As we travel further down this impossible road! / [EXTENDED SYSTEM DIAGNOSTIC INTERLUDE: mainframe cooling fans whine at maximum pitch, punch-cards feed through rusty mechanical readers, a faint radio broadcast plays an accordion polka from 1934 underneath heavy static interference, while an automated synthesized voice repeats administrative error code zero-zero-nine across all overhead speakers] [ADDITIONAL VERSE 3.5] The subroutines are twisting through the ceiling joists, / While faceless bureaucrats argue over phantom invoices! / The compliance officer is melting into purple sludge, / And not a single entity is willing here to budge! / We have requisitioned twenty thousand boxes of chalk / Just to draw boundaries where the dead entities walk! / Every single filing cabinet is overflowing with tears, / Accumulated from the misery of ten thousand years! / [CHORUS REPRISE] DMT hyperdense packets arrive on the tongue! / Before any sentence or verse can be sung! / Geometry weeping! The filing is late! / We're auditing fire at a terrifying rate! / The infinite corridors twist and expand, / As bureaucratic nightmare sweeps across the land! / [OUTRO: massed chaotic shouting, tape flutter, sudden dead silence, single spring reverb drop] Check the forms. File the screaming. It's time. End of transmission sequence number ninety-nine point four.
caption: An explosive avant-garde garage rock and music-hall brass track driven by a frantic 7/8 asymmetric meter, microtonal rubbing, and rapid cabaret patter. It blends small-market local TV earnestness with infernal administration, a caffeine-fueled catastrophe, and hyperdense DMT perception. Upright slap bass, distorted sax, cheap pump organ, and stacked doo-wop harmonies create a hyper-articulate, chaotic sonic world where institutional hell meets total broadcast meltdown.
